feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 October 2026 4:53pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 13 October 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds. Localised gales tomorrow afternoon.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the east of Iceland as a weak ridge of high pressure builds across the south of the island.


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight. Backing south or southwest and gradually increasing 6 or 7 through the morning tomorrow, then occasionally touching gale 8 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate overnight, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 6 or 7, touching gale 8 in places, gradually veering west or northwest 4 or 5 later on Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain arriving later Wednesday and overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, then becoming moderate or poor in rain later.
